result.instructions: Tools for Buk.ng, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which services can customers book right now, and what do they cost?"; "List this week's confirmed bookings and who is assigned to each."; "How many visits did our booking page get in the last 30 days, and where did they come from?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Buk.ng data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run buk_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run buk_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run buk_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. buk_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: buk_get_account
tools.title: Get API key and business
tools.description: Show the permissions (scopes) and mode (live or test) of the connected Buk.ng API key, and the business's name and timezone. Call it first to confirm the connection. Buk.ng API: GET /v1/me.

tools.name: buk_list_services
tools.title: List services
tools.description: List everything the business offers: name, description, duration in minutes, price (a decimal string in NGN) and whether it is bookable now. Not paged. Set active to true for bookable services only. Buk.ng API: GET /v1/services.

active.description: true = only services that can be booked now. Omit for all.

tools.name: buk_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List the business's customer records (id, name, phone, email, createdAt). Returns personal data. Look up one customer with email or phone, or page through all of them. One page per call: pass nextCursor back as cursor until it is null. Buk.ng API: GET /v1/customers.

email.description: Look up one customer by email (exact, not case-sensitive).

phone.description: Customer phone in international format, e.g. +2348031234567.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page. Omit on the first page. Pass it back unchanged.

tools.name: buk_list_bookings
tools.title: List bookings
tools.description: List appointments, newest first, with service, customer, staff (may be null), location, payment and join link. Filter by date range, status or your own externalReference. One page per call (up to 100): pass nextCursor back as cursor until it is null. Buk.ng API: GET /v1/bookings.

from.description: Only bookings that start on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

to.description: Only bookings that start on or before this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

status.description: Only bookings with this status. Omit for all statuses.

externalReference.description: Your own booking id. Returns that booking only.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page. Omit on the first page. Pass it back unchanged.

tools.name: buk_get_insights
tools.title: Get page insights
tools.description: Get visits to the business's booking page, Explore profile and website, where visitors came from, and what they did next. The response also has the previous period for comparison. Aggregates only. Needs a paid plan (Starter and above). Buk.ng API: GET /v1/insights.

tools.name: buk_get_website_insights
tools.title: Get website insights
tools.description: Get the live visit figures for the business's website (this hour and today against the usual) and the period report with top pages, devices and tips. Returns connected: false when no website reports to Buk. Needs a paid plan. Buk.ng API: GET /v1/website-insights.
